```text
        syncJST,
        getClockOffset,

        getJSTDateMillSec,

      // 1. サーバーと時刻同期（type="module" 内はトップレベル await が使える）
      await syncJST();

      // 2. 同期結果と現在時刻を取得
      const offset = getClockOffset();
      const iso = getJSTISOString();
      const compact = getJSTCptTs();
      const dateMs = getJSTDateMillSec();

      document.getElementById('output').textContent = JSON.stringify(
        {
          offset,
          iso,
          compact,
          dateMs,
        },
        null,
        2,
      );
```

# FILE: public/viewer/adapters/GeoJSONAdapter.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/adapters/GeoJSONAdapter.js

import {
    fetchGeoData,
    getFeatureBounds,
    toFeatureCollection
} from "../data-utils.js";

export class GeoJSONAdapter {

    constructor(map) {
        this.map = map;
        this.layers = new Map();
    }

    async load(layer) {
        if (this.layers.has(layer.id)) return;

        const geojson = await fetchGeoData(layer.path, "GeoJSON");
        const data = toFeatureCollection(geojson, "geojson");
        if (data.features.length === 0) {
            throw new Error(`GeoJSON has no drawable features: ${layer.path}`);
        }

        const mapLayerId = `geojson-${layer.id}`;
        this.map.addGeoJSONLayer({ id: mapLayerId, data });
        this.map.fitBounds(getFeatureBounds(data));
        this.layers.set(layer.id, mapLayerId);
    }

    hide(layerId) {
        const mapLayerId = this.layers.get(layerId);
        if (!mapLayerId) return;
        this.map.removeLayer(mapLayerId);
        this.layers.delete(layerId);
    }
}

```

# FILE: public/viewer/adapters/PMTilesAdapter.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/adapters/PMTilesAdapter.js

import * as maplibregl from '../vendor/maplibre-gl.mjs';

const { Protocol, PMTiles } = window.pmtiles;

let protocolInstalled = false;

/**
 * 実行環境に応じて PMTiles の参照先 URL を解決する
 */
function resolvePmtilesUrl(layer) {
  const isLocalHost =
    window.location.hostname === 'localhost' ||
    window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
    window.location.hostname === '[::1]';

  if (isLocalHost) {
    return layer.url || layer.path || layer.publicUrl;
  }
  return layer.publicUrl || layer.url || layer.path;
}

export class PMTilesAdapter {
  constructor(map, dictionaryManager = null) {
    this.map = map;
    this.dictionaryManager = dictionaryManager;
    this.sources = new Map();

    if (!protocolInstalled) {
      const protocol = new Protocol();
      maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', protocol.tile);
      protocolInstalled = true;
    }
  }

  async load(layer, { fitBounds = true } = {}) {
    const sourceId = `pmtiles-${layer.id}`;
    if (this.sources.has(layer.id)) return;

    const pmtilesUrl = resolvePmtilesUrl(layer);
    const archive = new PMTiles(pmtilesUrl);

    const [header, metadata] = await Promise.all([
      archive.getHeader(),
      archive.getMetadata().catch(() => ({})),
    ]);

    // 埋め込みメタデータ内の fieldLabels があれば辞書へ登録
    if (this.dictionaryManager && metadata?.description) {
      try {
        const descObj =
          typeof metadata.description === 'string'
            ? JSON.parse(metadata.description)
            : metadata.description;
        if (descObj?.fieldLabels) {
          this.dictionaryManager.registerEmbeddedFieldLabels(layer.id, descObj.fieldLabels);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const sourceLayer =
      layer.sourceLayer ?? metadata?.vector_layers?.[0]?.id ?? header?.json?.vector_layers?.[0]?.id;

    if (!sourceLayer) {
      throw new Error(`PMTiles has no vector layer metadata: ${pmtilesUrl}`);
    }

    this.map.addSource(sourceId, {
      type: 'vector',
      url: `pmtiles://${pmtilesUrl}`,
    });

    this.map.addLayer({
      id: `${sourceId}-fill`,
      source: sourceId,
      'source-layer': sourceLayer,
      type: 'fill',
      filter: ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'Polygon'],
      paint: {
        'fill-color': '#3388ff',
        'fill-opacity': 0.4,
      },
    });
    this.map.addLayer({
      id: `${sourceId}-line`,
      source: sourceId,
      'source-layer': sourceLayer,
      type: 'line',
      filter: ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'LineString'],
      paint: {
        'line-color': '#3388ff',
        'line-width': 2,
      },
    });
    this.map.addLayer({
      id: `${sourceId}-point`,
      source: sourceId,
      'source-layer': sourceLayer,
      type: 'circle',
      filter: ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'Point'],
      paint: {
        'circle-color': '#3388ff',
        'circle-radius': 5,
        'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
        'circle-stroke-width': 1,
      },
    });

    this.sources.set(layer.id, sourceId);

    // fitBounds が false の場合はカメラ移動を行わない
    if (!fitBounds) return;

    // バウンディングボックスの取得（header または metadata.bounds から取得）
    let bounds = null;
    if (
      Number.isFinite(header?.minLon) &&
      Number.isFinite(header?.minLat) &&
      Number.isFinite(header?.maxLon) &&
      Number.isFinite(header?.maxLat) &&
      header.minLon < header.maxLon &&
      header.minLat < header.maxLat
    ) {
      bounds = [
        [header.minLon, header.minLat],
        [header.maxLon, header.maxLat],
      ];
    } else if (Array.isArray(metadata?.bounds) && metadata.bounds.length === 4) {
      bounds = [
        [metadata.bounds[0], metadata.bounds[1]],
        [metadata.bounds[2], metadata.bounds[3]],
      ];
    }

    if (bounds) {
      this.map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: 40, maxZoom: 12 });
    } else {
      if (this.map.getZoom() < 9) {
        this.map.zoomTo(10);
      }
    }
  }

  hide(layerId) {
    const sourceId = this.sources.get(layerId);
    if (!sourceId) return;

    for (const suffix of ['fill', 'line', 'point']) {
      const layerName = `${sourceId}-${suffix}`;
      if (this.map.getLayer(layerName)) {
        this.map.removeLayer(layerName);
      }
    }

    if (this.map.getSource(sourceId)) {
      this.map.removeSource(sourceId);
    }

    this.sources.delete(layerId);
  }
}

```

# FILE: public/viewer/adapters/ServerVectorAdapter.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/adapters/ServerVectorAdapter.js

export class ServerVectorAdapter {

    constructor(viewerMap, onStatus = () => {}) {
        this.viewerMap = viewerMap;
        this.onStatus = onStatus;
        this.layers = new Map();
    }

    async fetchFeatures(layer, extent) {
        const bbox = extent.join(",");
        const url = `/api/layers/${encodeURIComponent(layer.id)}/features?bbox=${encodeURIComponent(bbox)}`;
        const response = await fetch(url);
        if (!response.ok) {
            const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            throw new Error(body.error ?? `GIS query failed (${response.status})`);
        }
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.type !== "FeatureCollection" || !Array.isArray(data.features)) {
            throw new Error("GIS feature API returned invalid GeoJSON");
        }
        return data;
    }

    async load(layer) {
        if (this.layers.has(layer.id)) return;

        const data = await this.fetchFeatures(layer, this.viewerMap.getExtent4326());

        const mapLayerId = `${layer.type}-${layer.id}`;
        this.viewerMap.addGeoJSONLayer({ id: mapLayerId, data });
        const state = { mapLayerId, requestId: 0, removeMoveListener: null };
        this.layers.set(layer.id, state);
        this.onStatus(data.truncated
            ? `${layer.name}: 表示範囲の地物が多いため先頭5,000件を表示しています。拡大すると残りも確認できます。`
            : "");

        state.removeMoveListener = this.viewerMap.onMoveEnd(async (extent) => {
            if (this.layers.get(layer.id) !== state) return;
            const requestId = ++state.requestId;
            try {
                const updated = await this.fetchFeatures(layer, extent);
                if (this.layers.get(layer.id) === state && state.requestId === requestId) {
                    this.viewerMap.updateGeoJSONLayer(mapLayerId, updated);
                    this.onStatus(updated.truncated
                        ? `${layer.name}: 表示範囲の地物が多いため先頭5,000件を表示しています。拡大すると残りも確認できます。`
                        : "");
                }
            } catch (error) {
                this.onStatus(`${layer.name}: ${error.message}`);
                console.error(`Failed to refresh ${layer.name}:`, error);
            }
        });

    }

    hide(layerId) {
        const state = this.layers.get(layerId);
        if (!state) return;
        state.requestId++;
        state.removeMoveListener?.();
        this.viewerMap.removeLayer(state.mapLayerId);
        this.layers.delete(layerId);
    }
}
```

# FILE: public/viewer/adapters/TopoJSONAdapter.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/adapters/TopoJSONAdapter.js

import {
    fetchGeoData,
    getFeatureBounds,
    toFeatureCollection
} from "../data-utils.js";

export class TopoJSONAdapter {

    constructor(map) {
        this.map = map;
        this.layers = new Map();
    }

    async load(layer) {
        if (this.layers.has(layer.id)) return;

        const topology = await fetchGeoData(layer.path, "TopoJSON");
        const data = toFeatureCollection(topology, "topojson");
        if (data.features.length === 0) {
            throw new Error(`TopoJSON has no drawable features: ${layer.path}`);
        }

        const mapLayerId = `topojson-${layer.id}`;
        this.map.addGeoJSONLayer({ id: mapLayerId, data });
        this.map.fitBounds(getFeatureBounds(data));
        this.layers.set(layer.id, mapLayerId);
    }

    hide(layerId) {
        const mapLayerId = this.layers.get(layerId);
        if (!mapLayerId) return;
        this.map.removeLayer(mapLayerId);
        this.layers.delete(layerId);
    }
}
```

# FILE: public/viewer/app.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/app.js

import * as maplibregl from './vendor/maplibre-gl.mjs';
import { ViewerMap } from './map.js';
import { loadCatalog, loadAllDatasets } from './catalog.js';
import { createLayerTree } from './layer-tree.js';
import { FieldDictionaryManager } from './i18n-dictionary.js';
import { PMTilesAdapter } from './adapters/PMTilesAdapter.js';
import { TopoJSONAdapter } from './adapters/TopoJSONAdapter.js';
import { GeoJSONAdapter } from './adapters/GeoJSONAdapter.js';
import { ServerVectorAdapter } from './adapters/ServerVectorAdapter.js';

const SERVER_ONLY_TYPES = new Set(['gpkg', 'parquet']);

async function checkServerAvailable() {
  const isLocalHost =
    window.location.hostname === 'localhost' ||
    window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
    window.location.hostname === '[::1]';

  if (!isLocalHost) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 1500);
    const res = await fetch('/healthz', {
      signal: controller.signal,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (!res.ok) return false;
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    return body?.status === 'ok';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function escapeHtml(text) {
  return String(text)
    .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
    .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
    .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
    .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
    .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');
}

function resolveLayerMetaFromMapLayerId(mapLayerId, layerMetaMap) {
  const stripped = mapLayerId
    .replace(/^(pmtiles|geojson|topojson|gpkg|parquet)-/, '')
    .replace(/-(fill|line|point)$/, '');
  return layerMetaMap.get(stripped) || null;
}

function buildFeaturePopupHTML(features, layerMetaMap, dictionaryManager) {
  const sections = features.slice(0, 5).map((feat) => {
    const layerMeta = resolveLayerMetaFromMapLayerId(feat.layer.id, layerMetaMap);
    const datasetId = layerMeta?.datasetId || 'unknown';
    const layerId = layerMeta?.id || null;
    const headerTitle = layerMeta?.name || dictionaryManager.getDatasetTitle(datasetId);

    const props = feat.properties || {};
    const rows = Object.entries(props)
      .filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('__'))
      .map(([key, val]) => {
        const label = dictionaryManager.formatFieldLabel(datasetId, key, layerId);
        const formattedVal = dictionaryManager.formatFieldValue(datasetId, key, val);
        return `
                    <tr>
                        <th style="text-align:left;padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;background:#f8f9fa;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;">${escapeHtml(label)}</th>
                        <td style="padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;word-break:break-all;">${escapeHtml(formattedVal)}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
      })
      .join('');

    return `
            <div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
                <div style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;color:#1a365d;border-bottom:2px solid #3388ff;padding-bottom:2px;">
                    ${escapeHtml(headerTitle)}
                </div>
                <table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:11px;">
                    <tbody>${rows || '<tr><td>属性データなし</td></tr>'}</tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        `;
  });

  return `<div style="max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:2px;">${sections.join('')}</div>`;
}

async function bootstrap() {
  const status = document.getElementById('viewerStatus');
  try {
    const viewerMap = new ViewerMap('map');
    await viewerMap.initialize();

    const map = viewerMap.getMap();
    const [serverAvailable, { dictionary }, catalog] = await Promise.all([
      checkServerAvailable(),
      loadCatalog(),
      loadAllDatasets(),
    ]);

    const dictionaryManager = new FieldDictionaryManager(dictionary);
    const pmtilesAdapter = new PMTilesAdapter(map, dictionaryManager);
    const geojsonAdapter = new GeoJSONAdapter(viewerMap);
    const topojsonAdapter = new TopoJSONAdapter(viewerMap);
    const serverVectorAdapter = new ServerVectorAdapter(viewerMap, (message) => {
      status.textContent = message;
    });
    const layerMetaMap = new Map(catalog.map((item) => [item.id, item]));

    if (catalog.length === 0) {
      status.textContent = 'public/data 内に表示可能なGISファイルがありません。';
    } else if (!serverAvailable) {
      const hasServerLayers = catalog.some((layer) => SERVER_ONLY_TYPES.has(layer.type));
      if (hasServerLayers) {
        status.textContent =
          '静的配信モード: gpkg / parquet はローカルサーバー起動時のみ表示できます。';
      }
    }

    let activePopup = null;
    let lastClickedState = null;

    const renderPopupAt = (lngLat, features) => {
      if (activePopup) {
        activePopup.remove();
        activePopup = null;
      }
      if (!features || features.length === 0) return;

      const html = buildFeaturePopupHTML(features, layerMetaMap, dictionaryManager);
      activePopup = new maplibregl.Popup({ maxWidth: '360px' })
        .setLngLat(lngLat)
        .setHTML(html)
        .addTo(map);
    };

    map.on('click', (e) => {
      const interactiveLayers = map
        .getStyle()
        .layers.filter((l) => l.id !== 'background' && !l.id.startsWith('basemap-layer-'))
        .map((l) => l.id);

      if (interactiveLayers.length === 0) return;
      const features = map.queryRenderedFeatures(e.point, { layers: interactiveLayers });
      if (features.length === 0) return;

      lastClickedState = { lngLat: e.lngLat, features };
      renderPopupAt(e.lngLat, features);
    });

    async function toggleLayer(layer, visible) {
      if (visible) {
        switch (layer.type) {
          case 'pmtiles':
            return pmtilesAdapter.load(layer);
          case 'topojson':
            return topojsonAdapter.load(layer);
          case 'geojson':
            return geojsonAdapter.load(layer);
          case 'gpkg':
          case 'parquet':
            if (!serverAvailable) {
              throw new Error('ローカルサーバー（ViewerServer）起動時のみ表示できます。');
            }
            return serverVectorAdapter.load(layer);
          default:
            throw new Error(`Unsupported GIS format: ${layer.type}`);
        }
      }

      switch (layer.type) {
        case 'pmtiles':
          return pmtilesAdapter.hide(layer.id);
        case 'topojson':
          return topojsonAdapter.hide(layer.id);
        case 'geojson':
          return geojsonAdapter.hide(layer.id);
        case 'gpkg':
        case 'parquet':
          return serverVectorAdapter.hide(layer.id);
      }
    }

    createLayerTree(catalog, toggleLayer, {
      serverAvailable,
      dictionaryManager,
      onDisplayModeChange: () => {
        if (activePopup?.isOpen() && lastClickedState) {
          renderPopupAt(lastClickedState.lngLat, lastClickedState.features);
        }
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    status.textContent = `地図ビューアーを初期化できませんでした: ${error.message}`;
    console.error(error);
  }
}

bootstrap();
```

# FILE: public/viewer/catalog.js

```js
// public/viewer/catalog.js

export async function loadCatalog() {
  const catalogUrl = new URL('../catalog.json', import.meta.url);
  const response = await fetch(catalogUrl, { cache: 'no-store' });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`catalog.json load failed : ${response.status}`);
  }

  const data = await response.json();

  // CatalogService.js が出力した短縮キー (c, pc, pn, fn, ds) を正規化
  const rawMunis = data?.municipalities || {};
  const municipalities = {};
  for (const [code, m] of Object.entries(rawMunis)) {
    municipalities[code] = {
      municipalityCode: m.c || code,
      prefectureCode: m.pc || code.slice(0, 2),
      prefectureName: m.pn || '',
      fullName: m.fn || '',
      bbox: m.bbox || null,
      datasetIds: Array.isArray(m.ds) ? m.ds : [],
    };
  }

  return {
    version: data?.version || 1,
    datasets: Array.isArray(data?.datasets) ? data.datasets : [],
    dictionary: data?.dictionary && typeof data.dictionary === 'object' ? data.dictionary : {},
    municipalities,
  };
}

/**
 * 指定した市区町村コードのデータセット一覧のみをオンデマンド取得（1〜5KB）
 */
export async function loadMunicipalityDatasets(muniCode) {
  const code = String(muniCode).padStart(5, '0');
  const url = new URL(`../catalog/muni/${code}.json`, import.meta.url);
  const response = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!response.ok) return [];
  return await response.json();
}

/**
 * /layers 全レイヤー一覧画面用：コンパクトタプルを展開して返す
 */
export async function loadAllDatasets() {
  const url = new URL('../catalog/all-datasets.json', import.meta.url);
  const response = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!response.ok) return [];
  const tuples = await response.json();
  return tuples.map(([id, name, layerUrl, datasetId, fileName, municipalityCode]) => ({
    id,
    name,
    url: layerUrl,
    path: layerUrl,
    type: 'pmtiles',
    datasetId,
    fileName,
    municipalityCode,
  }));
}
```

# FILE: public/viewer/citizen-app.js

```js
// public/viewer/citizen-app.js
import { ViewerMap } from './map.js';
import { loadCatalog, loadMunicipalityDatasets } from './catalog.js';
import { PMTilesAdapter } from './adapters/PMTilesAdapter.js';
import { FieldDictionaryManager } from './i18n-dictionary.js';
import { createCircleGeoJSON, getCircleBBox, intersectsBBox } from './citizen-geo.js';
import { CitizenUI } from './citizen-ui.js';
import { setupMapPopup } from './citizen-popup.js';

async function init() {
  try {
    const viewerMap = new ViewerMap('map');
    const map = await viewerMap.initialize();

    const { dictionary, municipalities } = await loadCatalog();
    const dictionaryManager = new FieldDictionaryManager(dictionary);
    const pmtilesAdapter = new PMTilesAdapter(map, dictionaryManager);

    const loadedLayerIds = new Set();

    function clearLoadedLayers() {
      for (const id of loadedLayerIds) {
        pmtilesAdapter.hide(id);
      }
      loadedLayerIds.clear();
    }

    function updateSearchCircle(geojson) {
      const sourceId = 'nearby-radius-circle';
      const fillId = 'nearby-radius-circle-fill';
      const lineId = 'nearby-radius-circle-line';

      if (!geojson) {
        if (map.getLayer(lineId)) map.removeLayer(lineId);
        if (map.getLayer(fillId)) map.removeLayer(fillId);
        if (map.getSource(sourceId)) map.removeSource(sourceId);
        return;
      }

      if (map.getSource(sourceId)) {
        map.getSource(sourceId).setData(geojson);
      } else {
        map.addSource(sourceId, { type: 'geojson', data: geojson });
        map.addLayer({
          id: fillId,
          type: 'fill',
          source: sourceId,
          paint: { 'fill-color': '#0284c7', 'fill-opacity': 0.12 },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: lineId,
          type: 'line',
          source: sourceId,
          paint: { 'line-color': '#0284c7', 'line-width': 2, 'line-dasharray': [4, 2] },
        });
      }
    }

    // options を受け取れるように変更
    async function handleToggleLayer(layer, checked, options = {}) {
      if (checked) {
        if (loadedLayerIds.has(layer.id)) return;
        await pmtilesAdapter.load(layer, options);
        loadedLayerIds.add(layer.id);
      } else {
        if (!loadedLayerIds.has(layer.id)) return;
        pmtilesAdapter.hide(layer.id);
        loadedLayerIds.delete(layer.id);
      }
    }

    const ui = new CitizenUI({
      municipalities,
      onSelectMuni: async (code) => {
        updateSearchCircle(null);
        clearLoadedLayers();

        const info = municipalities[code];
        const title = info?.fullName
          ? `${info.prefectureName || ''} ${info.fullName}`
          : `自治体コード: ${code}`;

        if (Array.isArray(info?.bbox) && info.bbox.length >= 4) {
          map.fitBounds(
            [
              [info.bbox[0], info.bbox[1]],
              [info.bbox[2], info.bbox[3]],
            ],
            { padding: 40, maxZoom: 14 },
          );
        }

        const list = await loadMunicipalityDatasets(code);
        const muniDatasetsMap = new Map([[code, list]]);
        await ui.renderMunicipalityLayers(muniDatasetsMap, title, false);
      },
      onToggleLayer: handleToggleLayer,
    });

    ui.initDropdowns();

    ui.btnNearby.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!navigator.geolocation) {
        alert('お使いのブラウザは位置情報取得に対応していません。');
        return;
      }

      ui.setNearbyLoading(true);

      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        async (pos) => {
          const { longitude: lon, latitude: lat } = pos.coords;
          const circleGeoJSON = createCircleGeoJSON(lon, lat, 500);
          updateSearchCircle(circleGeoJSON);
          clearLoadedLayers();

          const circleBBox = getCircleBBox(circleGeoJSON);
          const matchedCodes = Object.entries(municipalities)
            .filter(
              ([, info]) => info.datasetIds?.length > 0 && intersectsBBox(circleBBox, info.bbox),
            )
            .map(([code]) => code)
            .sort();

          const fetchedLists = await Promise.all(
            matchedCodes.map(async (code) => [code, await loadMunicipalityDatasets(code)]),
          );
          const muniDatasetsMap = new Map(fetchedLists.filter(([, list]) => list.length > 0));

          map.flyTo({ center: [lon, lat], zoom: 15 });
          await ui.renderMunicipalityLayers(
            muniDatasetsMap,
            '現在地から半径500m圏内の行政区域',
            true,
          );

          ui.setNearbyLoading(false);
        },
        (err) => {
          alert(`位置情報の取得に失敗しました: ${err.message}`);
          ui.setNearbyLoading(false);
        },
        { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 },
      );
    });

    setupMapPopup(map, dictionaryManager);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[citizen-app] Initialization failed:', err);
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('status-text');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = `初期化エラー: ${err.message}`;
  }
}

init();

```

```js
export function createCircleGeoJSON(lon, lat, radiusMeters = 500, steps = 64) {
  const coords = [];
  const earthRadius = 6378137;
  const latRad = (lat * Math.PI) / 180;

  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const angle = (i / steps) * 2 * Math.PI;
    const dx = radiusMeters * Math.cos(angle);
    const dy = radiusMeters * Math.sin(angle);
    const dLat = (dy / earthRadius) * (180 / Math.PI);
    const dLon = (dx / (earthRadius * Math.cos(latRad))) * (180 / Math.PI);
    coords.push([lon + dLon, lat + dLat]);
  }

  return {
    type: 'FeatureCollection',
    features: [
      {
        type: 'Feature',
        properties: { radius: radiusMeters },
        geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [coords] },
      },
    ],
  };
}

export function getCircleBBox(circleGeoJSON) {
  const ring = circleGeoJSON.features[0].geometry.coordinates[0];
  const lons = ring.map((c) => c[0]);
  const lats = ring.map((c) => c[1]);
  return [Math.min(...lons), Math.min(...lats), Math.max(...lons), Math.max(...lats)];
}

export function intersectsBBox(bboxA, bboxB) {
  if (!Array.isArray(bboxA) || !Array.isArray(bboxB) || bboxA.length < 4 || bboxB.length < 4) {
    return false;
  }
  return !(
    bboxA[2] < bboxB[0] ||
    bboxA[0] > bboxB[2] ||
    bboxA[3] < bboxB[1] ||
    bboxA[1] > bboxB[3]
  );
}
```

```js
// public/viewer/citizen-popup.js

import * as maplibregl from './vendor/maplibre-gl.mjs';

function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

export function setupMapPopup(map, dictionaryManager) {
  const excludedLayers = new Set([
    'background',
    'nearby-radius-circle-fill',
    'nearby-radius-circle-line',
  ]);

  map.on('click', (e) => {
    const style = map.getStyle();
    if (!style || !Array.isArray(style.layers)) return;

    const interactiveLayers = style.layers
      .filter((l) => !excludedLayers.has(l.id) && !l.id.startsWith('basemap-layer-'))
      .map((l) => l.id);

    if (interactiveLayers.length === 0) return;

    const features = map.queryRenderedFeatures(e.point, { layers: interactiveLayers });
    if (!features.length) return;

    const html = features
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map((f) => {
        const props = f.properties || {};
        const rows = Object.entries(props)
          .map(([k, v]) => {
            const label =
              typeof dictionaryManager?.getFieldLabel === 'function'
                ? dictionaryManager.getFieldLabel(k)
                : k;
            return `<tr><th>${escapeHtml(label)}</th><td>${escapeHtml(v)}</td></tr>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<div class="popup-layer-title">${escapeHtml(f.layer.id)}</div><table class="popup-table">${rows}</table>`;
      })
      .join('');

    new maplibregl.Popup({ maxWidth: '380px' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).setHTML(html).addTo(map);
  });
}
```

```js
// public/viewer/citizen-ui.js
import { PREF_NAMES } from './citizen-geo.js';

export class CitizenUI {
  constructor({ municipalities, onSelectMuni, onToggleLayer }) {
    this.municipalities = municipalities;
    this.onSelectMuni = onSelectMuni;
    this.onToggleLayer = onToggleLayer;

    this.topbar = document.getElementById('topbar');
    this.btnTopbarClose = document.getElementById('btn-topbar-close');
    this.btnTopbarOpen = document.getElementById('btn-topbar-open');

    this.prefSelect = document.getElementById('pref-select');
    this.muniSelect = document.getElementById('muni-select');
    this.btnNearby = document.getElementById('btn-nearby');

    this.drawer = document.getElementById('layer-drawer');
    this.btnDrawerOpen = document.getElementById('btn-drawer-open');
    this.btnDrawerClose = document.getElementById('btn-drawer-close');
    this.drawerTitle = document.getElementById('drawer-title');
    this.statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
    this.activeLayersEl = document.getElementById('active-layers');

    this.initTopbarControls();
    this.initDrawerControls();
  }

  initTopbarControls() {
    if (this.btnTopbarClose) {
      this.btnTopbarClose.addEventListener('click', () => this.collapseTopbar());
    }
    if (this.btnTopbarOpen) {
      this.btnTopbarOpen.addEventListener('click', () => this.expandTopbar());
    }
  }

  collapseTopbar() {
    if (this.topbar) this.topbar.classList.add('collapsed');
    if (this.btnTopbarOpen) this.btnTopbarOpen.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  expandTopbar() {
    if (this.topbar) this.topbar.classList.remove('collapsed');
    if (this.btnTopbarOpen) this.btnTopbarOpen.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  initDrawerControls() {
    if (this.btnDrawerClose) {
      this.btnDrawerClose.addEventListener('click', () => this.collapseDrawer());
    }
    if (this.btnDrawerOpen) {
      this.btnDrawerOpen.addEventListener('click', () => this.expandDrawer());
    }

    if (this.drawer) {
      let touchStartX = 0;
      let touchStartY = 0;
      this.drawer.addEventListener(
        'touchstart',
        (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
            touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
          }
        },
        { passive: true },
      );
      this.drawer.addEventListener(
        'touchend',
        (e) => {
          if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length > 0) {
            const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
            const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
            if (dx < -50 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
              this.collapseDrawer();
            }
          }
        },
        { passive: true },
      );
    }
  }

  collapseDrawer() {
    if (this.drawer) this.drawer.classList.add('collapsed');
    if (this.btnDrawerOpen) this.btnDrawerOpen.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  expandDrawer() {
    if (this.drawer) this.drawer.classList.remove('collapsed');
    if (this.btnDrawerOpen) this.btnDrawerOpen.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  initDropdowns() {
    const availablePrefs = new Map();
    for (const [code, info] of Object.entries(this.municipalities)) {
      if (!Array.isArray(info.datasetIds) || info.datasetIds.length === 0) continue;
      const prefCode = info.prefectureCode || code.slice(0, 2);
      if (!availablePrefs.has(prefCode)) {
        availablePrefs.set(prefCode, info.prefectureName || PREF_NAMES[prefCode] || '');
      }
    }

    for (const [prefCode, prefName] of Array.from(availablePrefs.entries()).sort()) {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = prefCode;
      opt.textContent = `${prefCode} ${prefName}`;
      this.prefSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }

    this.prefSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
      this.updateMuniDropdown(this.prefSelect.value);
    });

    this.muniSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const code = this.muniSelect.value;
      if (code && this.onSelectMuni) {
        this.onSelectMuni(code);
      }
    });
  }

  updateMuniDropdown(prefCode) {
    this.muniSelect.innerHTML = '';

    if (!prefCode) {
      this.muniSelect.disabled = true;
      this.muniSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">先に都道府県を選択</option>';
      return;
    }

    const muniCodes = Object.entries(this.municipalities)
      .filter(([code, info]) => code.startsWith(prefCode) && info.datasetIds?.length > 0)
      .map(([code]) => code)
      .sort();

    const defaultOpt = document.createElement('option');
    defaultOpt.value = '';
    defaultOpt.textContent = `市区町村を選択 (${muniCodes.length}件)`;
    this.muniSelect.appendChild(defaultOpt);

    for (const code of muniCodes) {
      const info = this.municipalities[code];
      const label = info?.fullName ? `${info.fullName} (${code})` : `自治体コード: ${code}`;
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = code;
      opt.textContent = label;
      this.muniSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }
    this.muniSelect.disabled = false;
  }

  setNearbyLoading(isLoading) {
    this.btnNearby.disabled = isLoading;
    this.btnNearby.textContent = isLoading
      ? '位置情報を取得中...'
      : '📍 現在地周辺（半径500m）を表示';
  }

  async renderMunicipalityLayers(muniDatasetsMap, title, autoLoadAdminOnly = false) {
    this.expandDrawer();
    this.activeLayersEl.innerHTML = '';
    this.drawerTitle.textContent = title;

    const entries = Array.from(muniDatasetsMap.entries());
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      this.statusText.textContent = '該当するデータが見つかりませんでした。';
      return;
    }

    // 結合済みPMTiles（都道府県／北海道振興局単位）と自治体固有レイヤーを分離し、
    // 同じ結合済みPMTilesの重複ロードを防止する
    const mergedLayerMap = new Map();
    const perMuniLayers = [];

    for (const [code, list] of entries) {
      const muniOnly = [];
      for (const layer of list) {
        if (layer.isMerged) {
          if (!mergedLayerMap.has(layer.id)) {
            mergedLayerMap.set(layer.id, layer);
          }
        } else {
          muniOnly.push(layer);
        }
      }
      if (muniOnly.length > 0) {
        perMuniLayers.push([code, muniOnly]);
      }
    }

    const totalUniqueLayers =
      mergedLayerMap.size + perMuniLayers.reduce((acc, [, l]) => acc + l.length, 0);
    this.statusText.textContent = `${totalUniqueLayers} 件のレイヤーを表示できます。チェックボックスで切り替えられます。`;

    const appendLayerGroup = async (groupTitle, layerList) => {
      if (layerList.length === 0) return;

      const groupEl = document.createElement('div');
      groupEl.className = 'dataset-group';

      const titleEl = document.createElement('div');
      titleEl.className = 'dataset-group-title';
      titleEl.textContent = groupTitle;
      groupEl.appendChild(titleEl);

      for (const layer of layerList) {
        const label = document.createElement('label');
        label.className = 'layer-item';

        const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
        checkbox.type = 'checkbox';

        // 97件一斉ロードによるフリーズを防ぐため、初期チェックは行政区域(N03)や特定データのみに限定する
        const isAdminPolygon =
          layer.datasetId === 'N03' || String(layer.fileName || '').startsWith('N03');
        checkbox.checked = isAdminPolygon;

        const text = document.createElement('span');
        text.textContent = `${layer.titleJa || layer.datasetId} (${layer.fileName})`;

        checkbox.addEventListener('change', async () => {
          try {
            await this.onToggleLayer(layer, checkbox.checked);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error(`レイヤー表示エラー (${layer.fileName}):`, err);
            checkbox.checked = false;
            alert(`このレイヤーはデータが空か、読み込めませんでした: ${layer.fileName}`);
          }
        });

        label.appendChild(checkbox);
        label.appendChild(text);
        groupEl.appendChild(label);

        if (checkbox.checked) {
          this.onToggleLayer(layer, true, { fitBounds: false }).catch((err) => {
            console.warn(`初期レイヤー読込スキップ (${layer.fileName}):`, err);
            checkbox.checked = false;
          });
        }
      }

      // まず画面にリストを描画する
      this.activeLayersEl.appendChild(groupEl);
    };

    // 1. 結合済み PMTiles（都道府県／振興局単位）をスコープ（振興局 or 都道府県）ごとに描画
    if (mergedLayerMap.size > 0) {
      const groupedMerged = new Map(); // scopeKey -> { label, layers }
      for (const layer of mergedLayerMap.values()) {
        const prefLabel = PREF_NAMES[layer.regionCode] || layer.regionCode || '広域';
        const scopeKey = layer.bureauCode || layer.regionCode || 'general';
        const scopeLabel = layer.bureauName
          ? `${prefLabel} ${layer.bureauName}（広域結合データ）`
          : `${prefLabel}（広域結合データ）`;

        if (!groupedMerged.has(scopeKey)) {
          groupedMerged.set(scopeKey, { label: scopeLabel, layers: [] });
        }
        groupedMerged.get(scopeKey).layers.push(layer);
      }

      for (const { label, layers } of groupedMerged.values()) {
        await appendLayerGroup(label, layers);
      }
    }

    // 2. 結合済みが存在しないフォールバックの市区町村別データがある場合のみ描画
    for (const [code, list] of perMuniLayers) {
      const info = this.municipalities[code];
      const muniLabel = info?.fullName ? `${info.fullName} (${code})` : `自治体コード: ${code}`;
      await appendLayerGroup(muniLabel, list);
    }
  }
}
```

# FILE: public/viewer/data-utils.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/data-utils.js

function parseJsonWithNonFiniteValues(source) {
    let output = "";
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;

    for (let index = 0; index < source.length;) {
        const character = source[index];

        if (inString) {
            output += character;
            if (escaped) {
                escaped = false;
            } else if (character === "\\") {
                escaped = true;
            } else if (character === "\"") {
                inString = false;
            }
            index++;
            continue;
        }

        if (character === "\"") {
            inString = true;
            output += character;
            index++;
            continue;
        }

        const token = source.slice(index).match(/^-?(?:NaN|Infinity)\b/);
        if (token) {
            const previous = source[index - 1];
            const next = source[index + token[0].length];
            if (
                (previous === ":" || previous === "," || previous === "[" || /\s/.test(previous ?? ""))
                && (next === "," || next === "]" || next === "}" || /\s/.test(next ?? ""))
            ) {
                output += "null";
                index += token[0].length;
                continue;
            }
        }

        output += character;
        index++;
    }

    return JSON.parse(output);
}

export async function fetchGeoData(url, formatName) {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`${formatName} load failed (${response.status}): ${url}`);
    }
    return parseJsonWithNonFiniteValues(await response.text());
}

function transformedPoint(point, transform) {
    if (!Array.isArray(point) || point.length < 2) return null;
    if (!transform) {
        return point.every(Number.isFinite) ? point : null;
    }

    const [scaleX, scaleY] = transform.scale;
    const [translateX, translateY] = transform.translate;
    const transformed = [
        point[0] * scaleX + translateX,
        point[1] * scaleY + translateY,
        ...point.slice(2)
    ];
    return transformed.every(Number.isFinite) ? transformed : null;
}

function decodeArcs(topology) {
    const transform = topology.transform;
    return (topology.arcs ?? []).map((arc) => {
        let x = 0;
        let y = 0;
        const points = [];

        for (const point of arc) {
            if (!Array.isArray(point) || point.length < 2) continue;
            if (transform) {
                x += point[0];
                y += point[1];
                const decoded = transformedPoint([x, y, ...point.slice(2)], transform);
                if (decoded) points.push(decoded);
            } else if (point.every(Number.isFinite)) {
                points.push(point);
            }
        }
        return points;
    });
}

function joinArcs(references, arcs) {
    const coordinates = [];
    for (const reference of references ?? []) {
        if (!Number.isInteger(reference)) continue;
        const index = reference < 0 ? ~reference : reference;
        const arc = arcs[index];
        if (!arc) continue;
        const points = reference < 0 ? [...arc].reverse() : arc;
        coordinates.push(...(coordinates.length ? points.slice(1) : points));
    }
    return coordinates;
}

function convertGeometry(geometry, arcs, transform) {
    if (!geometry || typeof geometry !== "object") return null;

    if (geometry.type === "Feature") {
        return geometry.geometry ? [geometry] : [];
    }

    if (geometry.type === "GeometryCollection") {
        return (geometry.geometries ?? []).flatMap((child) =>
            convertGeometry(child, arcs, transform) ?? []
        );
    }

    let converted;
    switch (geometry.type) {
        case "Point":
            converted = {
                type: "Point",
                coordinates: transformedPoint(geometry.coordinates, transform)
            };
            break;
        case "MultiPoint":
            converted = {
                type: "MultiPoint",
                coordinates: (geometry.coordinates ?? [])
                    .map((point) => transformedPoint(point, transform))
                    .filter(Boolean)
            };
            break;
        case "LineString":
            converted = { type: geometry.type, coordinates: joinArcs(geometry.arcs, arcs) };
            break;
        case "MultiLineString":
        case "Polygon":
            converted = {
                type: geometry.type,
                coordinates: (geometry.arcs ?? []).map((ring) => joinArcs(ring, arcs))
            };
            break;
        case "MultiPolygon":
            converted = {
                type: geometry.type,
                coordinates: (geometry.arcs ?? []).map((polygon) =>
                    polygon.map((ring) => joinArcs(ring, arcs))
                )
            };
            break;
        default:
            return null;
    }

    if (converted.coordinates == null) return [];
    return [{
        type: "Feature",
        id: geometry.id,
        properties: geometry.properties ?? {},
        geometry: converted
    }];
}

export function toFeatureCollection(data, format) {
    if (data?.type === "FeatureCollection" && Array.isArray(data.features)) {
        return data;
    }
    if (data?.type === "Feature") {
        return { type: "FeatureCollection", features: [data] };
    }

    if (format === "topojson" && data?.type === "Topology") {
        const objects = Object.values(data.objects ?? {});
        const arcs = decodeArcs(data);
        const features = objects.flatMap((object) => {
            if (object.type !== "GeometryCollection") {
                return convertGeometry(object, arcs, data.transform) ?? [];
            }
            return (object.geometries ?? []).flatMap((geometry) =>
                convertGeometry(geometry, arcs, data.transform) ?? []
            );
        });
        return { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
    }

    throw new Error(`Unsupported ${format} data structure`);
}

export function getFeatureBounds(featureCollection) {
    let minX = Infinity;
    let minY = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity;
    let maxY = -Infinity;

    const visit = (coordinates) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(coordinates)) return;
        if (
            coordinates.length >= 2
            && Number.isFinite(coordinates[0])
            && Number.isFinite(coordinates[1])
        ) {
            minX = Math.min(minX, coordinates[0]);
            minY = Math.min(minY, coordinates[1]);
            maxX = Math.max(maxX, coordinates[0]);
            maxY = Math.max(maxY, coordinates[1]);
            return;
        }
        for (const child of coordinates) visit(child);
    };

    for (const feature of featureCollection.features ?? []) {
        visit(feature?.geometry?.coordinates);
    }
    return Number.isFinite(minX) ? [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] : null;
}
```

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/getJST.js
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// JST Utility Functions
// 日本標準時（JST）を扱うためのユーティリティ関数群。
// ------------------------------------------------------------
/**
 * getJSTParts()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * 現在時刻の JST 構成要素を取得する。
 * Returns decomposed date/time parts in JST.
 */
function getJSTParts() {
  const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
    fractionalSecondDigits: 3,
    hour12: false,
  });

  const parts = formatter.formatToParts(new Date());

  const get = (type) =>
    parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value ?? '';

  return {
    yyyy: get('year'),
    mm: get('month'),
    dd: get('day'),
    hh: get('hour'),
    mi: get('minute'),
    ss: get('second'),
    ms: get('fractionalSecond'),
  };
}
/**
 * getJSTISOString()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * 日本時間（JST）の ISO8601 文字列（ミリ秒あり）を返す。
 * Returns an ISO8601 timestamp in JST with milliseconds.
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   2026-10-11T06:19:10.414+09:00
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - 精密ログ
 * - API 出力
 * - 時刻の厳密比較が必要な場面
 */
export function getJSTISOString() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd, hh, mi, ss, ms } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}T${hh}:${mi}:${ss}.${ms}+09:00`;
}
/**
 * getJSTISOStringNoMs()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * 日本時間（JST）の ISO8601 文字列（ミリ秒なし）を返す。
 * Returns an ISO8601 timestamp in JST without milliseconds.
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   2026-10-11T06:19:10+09:00
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - ミリ秒不要のログ
 * - ファイル名や簡易的な時刻表現
 */
export function getJSTISOStringNoMs() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd, hh, mi, ss } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}T${hh}:${mi}:${ss}+09:00`;
}
/**
 * getJSTTimestamp()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * ログ向けの読みやすい JST タイムスタンプを返す。
 * Returns a human‑readable JST timestamp for logs.
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   2026-10-11_06:19:10
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - ログファイル名
 * - 人間が読むログ出力
 */
export function getJSTTimestamp() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd, hh, mi, ss } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}_${hh}:${mi}:${ss}`;
}
/**
 * getJSTCptTs()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * コンパクトな JST タイムスタンプ（ファイル名向け）。
 * Returns a compact ISO8601-like JST timestamp for filenames.
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   20261011T061910_jst
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - ファイル名
 * - ZIP 情報のスナップショット
 */
export function getJSTCptTs() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd, hh, mi, ss } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}${mm}${dd}T${hh}${mi}${ss}_jst`;
}
/**
 * getJSTDate()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * 日本時間（JST）の日付（YYYYMMDD）を返す。
 * Returns a JST date string in YYYYMMDD format.
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   20261011
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - zipList.json の scanDate
 * - 日付単位の処理識別子
 * - 差分処理・途中再開の基準
 */
export function getJSTDate() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}${mm}${dd}`;
}
/**
 * getJSTMillSec()
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * 日本時間（JST）の時刻（HHMMSSmmm）を返す（ミリ秒まで）。
 * Returns a compact JST time string including milliseconds (HHMMSSmmm).
 *
 * 例 / Example:
 *   061910416
 *
 * 用途 / Usage:
 * - zipList.json の scanTime（ZIP スキャン時刻の一意性確保）
 * - 並列処理時の衝突回避
 * - ZIP の順序管理（order と組み合わせて完全一意化）
 */
export function getJSTMillSec() {
  const { hh, mi, ss, ms } = getJSTParts();
  return `${hh}${mi}${ss}${ms}`;
}

export function getJSTDateMillSec() {
  const { yyyy, mm, dd, hh, mi, ss, ms } = getJSTParts();
  return `${yyyy}${mm}${dd}T${hh}${mi}${ss}${ms}_jst`;
}
```

# FILE: public/viewer/i18n-dictionary.js

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/i18n-dictionary.js

export const DISPLAY_MODES = [
  { id: 'code_ja', label: 'コード＋日本語 (N03_001（都道府県名）)' },
  { id: 'ja_only', label: '日本語のみ (都道府県名)' },
  { id: 'bilingual', label: '日英併記 (都道府県名 / English)' },
  { id: 'code_only', label: 'フィールドコードのみ (N03_001)' },
];

// 将来的に他言語辞書JSONを外部からマージ可能にする拡張レジストリ
const externalLangPacks = new Map();

export class FieldDictionaryManager {
  constructor(dictionary = {}) {
    this.dictionary = dictionary || {};
    this.embeddedMetadataCache = new Map();
    this.mode = 'code_ja';
    this.primaryLang = 'ja';
  }

  setMode(mode) {
    this.mode = mode;
  }

  setPrimaryLang(lang) {
    this.primaryLang = lang;
  }

  /**
   * 将来的に en / zh-TW / th / ru 等の追加翻訳パックを動的ロード・マージする口
   */
  registerLanguagePack(langCode, packData) {
    externalLangPacks.set(langCode, packData);
    for (const [datasetId, dsPatch] of Object.entries(packData || {})) {
      if (!this.dictionary[datasetId]) {
        this.dictionary[datasetId] = { datasetId, dataName: {}, fields: {} };
      }
      if (dsPatch.dataName) {
        Object.assign(this.dictionary[datasetId].dataName, dsPatch.dataName);
      }
      for (const [fieldCode, labels] of Object.entries(dsPatch.fields || {})) {
        if (!this.dictionary[datasetId].fields[fieldCode]) {
          this.dictionary[datasetId].fields[fieldCode] = {};
        }
        Object.assign(this.dictionary[datasetId].fields[fieldCode], labels);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * PMTiles 内部メタデータ（description JSON の fieldLabels）をキャッシュ登録
   */
  registerEmbeddedFieldLabels(layerId, fieldLabels) {
    if (fieldLabels && typeof fieldLabels === 'object') {
      this.embeddedMetadataCache.set(layerId, fieldLabels);
    }
  }

  getDatasetTitle(datasetId) {
    const entry = this.dictionary?.[datasetId];
    if (!entry) return datasetId;
    const primary = entry.dataName?.[this.primaryLang] || entry.dataName?.ja || datasetId;
    const en = entry.dataName?.en;
    if (this.mode === 'bilingual' && en && en !== primary) {
      return `${primary} / ${en} (${datasetId})`;
    }
    return primary !== datasetId ? `${primary} (${datasetId})` : datasetId;
  }

  formatFieldLabel(datasetId, fieldCode, layerId = null) {
    const fieldDef = this.dictionary?.[datasetId]?.fields?.[fieldCode];
    const embeddedAlias = layerId ? this.embeddedMetadataCache.get(layerId)?.[fieldCode] : null;

    if (this.mode === 'code_only') {
      return fieldCode;
    }

    const jaLabel = fieldDef?.ja || (embeddedAlias ? embeddedAlias.replace(/^[^（]+（|）$/g, '') : '');
    const primaryLabel = fieldDef?.[this.primaryLang] || jaLabel;
    const enLabel = fieldDef?.en || '';

    if (!primaryLabel) {
      return embeddedAlias || fieldCode;
    }

    if (this.mode === 'ja_only') {
      return primaryLabel;
    }

    if (this.mode === 'bilingual') {
      const biText = enLabel && enLabel !== primaryLabel ? `${primaryLabel} / ${enLabel}` : primaryLabel;
      return `${biText} (${fieldCode})`;
    }

    // デフォルト: N03_001（都道府県名）
    return `${fieldCode}（${primaryLabel}）`;
  }

  /**
   * 属性値がコードリストに一致する場合に人間が読める解説を併記する
   */
  formatFieldValue(datasetId, fieldCode, rawValue) {
    if (rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined || rawValue === '') {
      return '—';
    }
    const strVal = String(rawValue);
    const codeLists = this.dictionary?.[datasetId]?.codeLists;
    if (!codeLists) return strVal;

    // フィールドに紐づくコードリスト定義を検索
    for (const cl of Object.values(codeLists)) {
      if (cl?.items && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cl.items, strVal)) {
        return `${strVal}（${cl.items[strVal]}）`;
      }
    }
    return strVal;
  }
}
```

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/layer-tree.js

import { DISPLAY_MODES } from "./i18n-dictionary.js";

const SERVER_ONLY_TYPES = new Set(["gpkg", "parquet"]);

export function createLayerTree(
    layers,
    handler,
    { serverAvailable = true, dictionaryManager = null, onDisplayModeChange = null } = {}
) {
    const root = document.getElementById("layerTree");
    const status = document.getElementById("viewerStatus");

    // 表示形式・言語モード切替UI
    if (dictionaryManager) {
        const modeBox = document.createElement("div");
        modeBox.className = "layer-display-mode";
        modeBox.style.marginBottom = "8px";
        modeBox.style.paddingBottom = "8px";
        modeBox.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #ddd";

        const modeLabel = document.createElement("label");
        modeLabel.textContent = "属性ラベル表記: ";
        modeLabel.style.fontSize = "12px";
        modeLabel.style.display = "block";
        modeLabel.style.marginBottom = "4px";

        const select = document.createElement("select");
        select.style.width = "100%";
        select.style.fontSize = "12px";
        select.style.padding = "3px";

        for (const mode of DISPLAY_MODES) {
            const opt = document.createElement("option");
            opt.value = mode.id;
            opt.textContent = mode.label;
            select.appendChild(opt);
        }

        select.addEventListener("change", () => {
            dictionaryManager.setMode(select.value);
            onDisplayModeChange?.(select.value);
        });

        modeBox.append(modeLabel, select);
        root.appendChild(modeBox);
    }

    for (const layer of layers) {
        const isServerOnly = SERVER_ONLY_TYPES.has(layer.type);
        const disabledByEnv = isServerOnly && !serverAvailable;

        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "layer-row";

        const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
        checkbox.type = "checkbox";
        checkbox.id = `layer-${layer.id}`;
        checkbox.disabled = disabledByEnv;

        if (!disabledByEnv) {
            checkbox.addEventListener("change", async () => {
                checkbox.disabled = true;
                status.textContent = "";
                try {
                    await handler(layer, checkbox.checked);
                } catch (error) {
                    checkbox.checked = false;
                    status.textContent = `${layer.name}: ${error.message}`;
                    console.error(error);
                } finally {
                    checkbox.disabled = false;
                }
            });
        }

        const label = document.createElement("label");
        label.htmlFor = checkbox.id;
        label.textContent = disabledByEnv
            ? `${layer.name} (${layer.type} - ローカルサーバー専用)`
            : `${layer.name} (${layer.type})`;

        if (disabledByEnv) {
            label.style.opacity = "0.55";
            label.title = "GitHub Pages等の静的環境では利用できません";
        }

        row.append(checkbox, label);
        root.appendChild(row);
    }
}
```

```js
// Workspace/publicRepos/JapanHazardMap/japanhazardmap.github.io/public/viewer/map.js

import * as maplibregl from './vendor/maplibre-gl.mjs';

import { BASEMAPS } from "./basemaps.js";
/**
 * ベースマップ切替用のカスタムコントロール（MapLibre IControl 準拠）
 */
class BasemapSwitcherControl {
    constructor(basemaps, initialId, onChange) {
        this.basemaps = basemaps;
        this.currentId = initialId;
        this.onChange = onChange;
    }

    onAdd() {
        this.container = document.createElement("div");
        this.container.className = "maplibregl-ctrl maplibregl-ctrl-group";
        this.container.style.padding = "4px";
        this.container.style.background = "#ffffff";

        const select = document.createElement("select");
        select.ariaLabel = "背景地図の切り替え";
        select.style.fontSize = "12px";
        select.style.padding = "3px 6px";
        select.style.border = "1px solid #ccc";
        select.style.borderRadius = "3px";
        select.style.cursor = "pointer";
        select.style.background = "#fff";

        for (const bm of Object.values(this.basemaps)) {
            const option = document.createElement("option");
            option.value = bm.id;
            option.textContent = bm.label;
            if (bm.id === this.currentId) {
                option.selected = true;
            }
            select.appendChild(option);
        }

        select.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
            this.currentId = e.target.value;
            this.onChange(this.currentId);
        });

        this.container.appendChild(select);
        return this.container;
    }

    onRemove() {
        this.container?.remove();
    }
}

export class ViewerMap {

    constructor(containerId = "map") {
        this.containerId = containerId;
        this.map = null;
        this.loadedLayers = new Map();
        this.currentBasemapId = "pale"; // 初期表示は淡色地図
    }

    async initialize() {
        console.log("map.js loaded");

        if (this.map) {
            return this.map;
        }

        // 全ベースマップの raster ソースとレイヤーを初期スタイルに組み込む
        const sources = {};
        const layers = [
            {
                id: "background",
                type: "background",
                paint: {
                    "background-color": "#f5f5f5"
                }
            }
        ];

        for (const bm of Object.values(BASEMAPS)) {
            if (!bm.tiles) continue;

            sources[`basemap-${bm.id}`] = {
                type: "raster",
                tiles: bm.tiles,
                tileSize: 256,
                attribution: bm.attribution,
                maxzoom: bm.maxzoom || 18
            };

            layers.push({
                id: `basemap-layer-${bm.id}`,
                type: "raster",
                source: `basemap-${bm.id}`,
                layout: {
                    visibility: bm.id === this.currentBasemapId ? "visible" : "none"
                }
            });
        }

        this.map = new maplibregl.Map({
            container: this.containerId,
            style: {
                version: 8,
                sources,
                layers
            },
            center: [135.5023, 34.6937],
            zoom: 5
        });

        // ズーム・回転コントロール
        this.map.addControl(
            new maplibregl.NavigationControl(),
            "top-right"
        );

        // 背景地図切替コントロール
        this.map.addControl(
            new BasemapSwitcherControl(BASEMAPS, this.currentBasemapId, (id) => {
                this.setBasemap(id);
            }),
            "top-right"
        );

        // スケールバー（縮尺表示）
        this.map.addControl(
            new maplibregl.ScaleControl({ maxWidth: 120, unit: "metric" }),
            "bottom-left"
        );

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.map.on("load", () => resolve(this.map));
        });
    }

    /**
     * 背景地図を切り替える
     */
    setBasemap(basemapId) {
        if (!this.map || !BASEMAPS[basemapId]) return;
        this.currentBasemapId = basemapId;

        for (const bm of Object.values(BASEMAPS)) {
            if (!bm.tiles) continue;
            const layerId = `basemap-layer-${bm.id}`;
            if (this.map.getLayer(layerId)) {
                this.map.setLayoutProperty(
                    layerId,
                    "visibility",
                    bm.id === basemapId ? "visible" : "none"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    getMap() {
        return this.map;
    }

    // ...（以降の addGeoJSONLayer / updateGeoJSONLayer / setVisible / removeLayer / fitBounds / getExtent4326 / onMoveEnd は既存コードのまま）...
    addGeoJSONLayer({
        id,
        data,
        color = "#3388ff",
        visible = true
    }) {

        if (this.map.getSource(`${id}-source`)) {
            this.removeLayer(id);
        }

        this.map.addSource(
            `${id}-source`,
            {
                type: "geojson",
                data
            }
        );

        this.map.addLayer({
            id: `${id}-fill`,
            source: `${id}-source`,
            type: "fill",
            filter: ["==", ["geometry-type"], "Polygon"],
            paint: {
                "fill-color": color,
                "fill-opacity": 0.4
            }
        });

        this.map.addLayer({
            id: `${id}-line`,
            source: `${id}-source`,
            type: "line",
            filter: ["==", ["geometry-type"], "LineString"],
            paint: {
                "line-color": color,
                "line-width": 2
            }
        });

        this.map.addLayer({
            id: `${id}-point`,
            source: `${id}-source`,
            type: "circle",
            filter: ["==", ["geometry-type"], "Point"],
            paint: {
                "circle-color": color,
                "circle-radius": 5,
                "circle-stroke-color": "#ffffff",
                "circle-stroke-width": 1
            }
        });

        this.loadedLayers.set(id, true);
        this.setVisible(id, visible);
    }

    updateGeoJSONLayer(id, data) {
        const source = this.map.getSource(`${id}-source`);
        if (!source) {
            throw new Error(`Map layer is not loaded: ${id}`);
        }
        source.setData(data);
    }

    setVisible(
        layerId,
        visible
    ) {

        for (const suffix of ["fill", "line", "point"]) {
            const id = `${layerId}-${suffix}`;
            if (this.map.getLayer(id)) {
                this.map.setLayoutProperty(
                    id,
                    "visibility",
                    visible ? "visible" : "none"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    removeLayer(
        layerId
    ) {

        for (const suffix of ["fill", "line", "point"]) {
            const id = `${layerId}-${suffix}`;
            if (this.map.getLayer(id)) {
                this.map.removeLayer(id);
            }
        }

        if (this.map.getSource(`${layerId}-source`)) {
            this.map.removeSource(`${layerId}-source`);
        }

        this.loadedLayers.delete(
            layerId
        );
    }

    fitBounds(bounds) {
        if (bounds && bounds.length === 4 && bounds.every(Number.isFinite)) {
            this.map.fitBounds(
                [[bounds[0], bounds[1]], [bounds[2], bounds[3]]],
                { padding: 40, maxZoom: 12 }
            );
        }
    }

    getExtent4326() {

        const bounds =
            this.map.getBounds();

        return [

            bounds.getWest(),
            bounds.getSouth(),

            bounds.getEast(),
            bounds.getNorth()
        ];
    }

    onMoveEnd(
        callback
    ) {

        const handler = () => callback(this.getExtent4326());
        this.map.on("moveend", handler);
        return () => this.map.off("moveend", handler);
    }
}
```
